
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper05" title="发布于 2025-12-05 08:30">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MAF快速入门（5）开发自定义Executor</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251203214259190-896036614.png" alt="MAF快速入门（5）开发自定义Executor" class="desc_img">
        上一篇，我们学习了MAF中进行多Agent智能体的顺序和移交编排。但是，很多时候我们想要嵌入一些业务逻辑和结构化输出，亦或者是需要保持历史对话，这时我们就可以开发一些自定义Executor来组成工作流。本文介绍了Executor的基本概念 以及 如何开发自定义Executor，然后给出了一个营销文案生成审核的工作流案例详细介绍了自定义Executor的应用。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span><span>大家好，我是Edison。</span></span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper04" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2"><span>上一篇</span></a><span>，我们学习了MAF中进行多Agent智能体的顺序和移交编排<span>。但是，很多时候我们想要嵌入一些业务逻辑和结构化输出，亦或者是需要保持历史对话，这时我们就可以开发一些自定义Executor来组成工作流。</span></span></span></p>
<h1><strong>什么是Executor？</strong></h1>
<p><span><span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>Executor又称为执行器，它是<span>MAF中处理工作流消息的基本构建模块，是接受结构化消息、执行并生成输出结果消息或事件的独立单元<span>。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><strong><span><span>很多时候，我们想要封装一些复杂的业务流程到Agent的工作流中，又或者想要完全控制Agent的生命周期和对话历史，这时候我们就需要开发一些自定义的Executor。</span></span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span><span>例如，我们想要做一些严格的评分判断、循环控制、条件终止的业务逻辑，就需要自定义Executor了。</span></span></strong></p>
<p><span><span>这里以一个智能营销文案的场景为例，假设一个企业有两个专家，一个专门负责编写文案，另一个则负责对文案进行审核评分。只有当撰写的文案通过审核负责人的审核（假设量化指标：评分&gt;=8）才能进行发布，否则文案编写者需要根据审核人提供的反馈改进建议进行反复修改。</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251203213516715-548024236.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 12px">案例来自圣杰《<a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzA4NzQzNTg4Ng==&amp;mid=2651744458&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=139f7584e81aeecd0945133bdc2b4791&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">.NET + AI 智能体开发进阶</a>》</span></p>
<p>由上图可知，这里不仅需要文案专家 和 审核专家 嵌入一些评分和反馈的逻辑，还要设置循环和终止的条件，才能让这个工作流能够比较准确的满足企业的需求。因此，我们就需要开发两个自定义的Executor来封装文案撰写 和 文案审核的Agent。</p>
<p>那么，哪些场景不需要自定义Executor呢？</p>
<p>比如，就只需要一次性Agent的调用输出回答，又或者不需要嵌入严格的业务逻辑的场景。</p>
<p>下面，就让我们来一一实现这个案例。</p>
<h1><strong>准备工作</strong></h1>
<p><span>在今天的这个案例中，我们创建了一个.NET控制台应用程序，安装了以下NuGet包：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>Microsoft.Agents.AI.OpenAI</span></li>
<li><span>Microsoft.Agents.AI.Workflows</span></li>
<li><span>Microsoft.Extensions.AI.OpenAI</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>我们的配置文件中定义了LLM API的信息：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OpenAI</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">EndPoint</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://api.siliconflow.cn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ApiKey</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">******************************</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ModelId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>这里我们使用 SiliconCloud 提供<span><span>的<span><span>&nbsp;<span><span>Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507&nbsp;<span><span>模型，之前的 Qwen2.5 模型在这个案例中不适用。你<span><span>可以通过这个URL注册账号：<span><span><a href="https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/i/DomqCefW" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/i/DomqCefW</a><span>&nbsp;获取大量免费的Token来进行本次实验。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>然后，我们将配置文件中的API信息读取出来：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> config = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConfigurationBuilder()
    .AddJsonFile($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">appsettings.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, optional: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>, reloadOnChange: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .Build();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> openAIProvider = config.GetSection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OpenAI</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).Get&lt;OpenAIProvider&gt;();</pre>
</div>
<h1><span>定义数据传输模型</span></h1>
<p><span><span>首先，我们定义一下在这个工作流中需要生成传递的数据模型：</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>（1）SloganResult ：文案生成结果</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 文案生成结果
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SloganResult
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 产品任务描述
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    [JsonPropertyName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">task</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Task { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成的标语
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    [JsonPropertyName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">slogan</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Slogan { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>（2）FeedbackResult：审核反馈结果</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 审核反馈结果

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 审核评论

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>

<h1 data-pm-slice="2 3 []"><span>定义自定义事件</span></h1>
<p>MAF中定义了一个WorkflowEvent的基类，所有自定义Event都需要继承于它。</p>
<p>（1）SloganGeneratedEvent ：文案已生成事件</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SloganGeneratedEvent : WorkflowEvent
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SloganResult _sloganResult;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SloganGeneratedEvent(SloganResult sloganResult) 
        : </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(sloganResult)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._sloganResult =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sloganResult;
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> ToString() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        $</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📝 [标语生成] {_sloganResult.Slogan}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>（2）FeedbackFinishedEvent : 反馈已完成事件</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自定义事件:审核反馈完成
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FeedbackFinishedEvent : WorkflowEvent
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FeedbackResult _feedbackResult;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FeedbackFinishedEvent(FeedbackResult feedbackResult) 
        : </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(feedbackResult)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._feedbackResult =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> feedbackResult;
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> ToString() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        $</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        📊 [审核反馈]
        评分: {_feedbackResult.Rating}</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        评论: {_feedbackResult.Comments}
        建议: {_feedbackResult.Actions}
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">;</span>
}</pre>
</div>
<h1><span>开发文案生成Executor</span></h1>
<p>MAF中定义了一个Executor的基类，所有自定义Exectuor都需要继承于它。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 文案生成 Executor - 根据任务或反馈生成标语
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SloganWriterExecutor : Executor
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AIAgent _agent;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentThread _thread;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化文案生成 Executor
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="id"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">Executor 唯一标识</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="chatClient"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">AI 聊天客户端</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> SloganWriterExecutor(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> id, IChatClient chatClient) : <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(id)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置 Agent 选项</span>
        ChatClientAgentOptions agentOptions = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
            instructions: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是一名专业的文案撰写专家。你将根据产品特性创作简洁有力的宣传标语。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        )
        {
            ChatOptions </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置结构化输出：要求返回 SloganResult JSON 格式</span>
                ResponseFormat = ChatResponseFormat.ForJsonSchema&lt;SloganResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
            }
        };
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建 Agent 和对话线程</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._agent = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatClientAgent(chatClient, agentOptions);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._thread = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">._agent.GetNewThread();
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置消息路由：支持两种输入类型
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> RouteBuilder ConfigureRoutes(RouteBuilder routeBuilder) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        routeBuilder
            .AddHandler</span>&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, SloganResult&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.HandleInitialTaskAsync)      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理初始任务</span>
            .AddHandler&lt;FeedbackResult, SloganResult&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.HandleFeedbackAsync);  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理反馈</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理初始任务（首次生成）
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> ValueTask&lt;SloganResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HandleInitialTaskAsync(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> message,
        IWorkflowContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✍️ [文案生成] 接收到任务: {message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用 Agent 生成标语</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._agent.RunAsync(message, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">._thread, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 反序列化结构化输出</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> sloganResult = JsonSerializer.Deserialize&lt;SloganResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(result.Text)
            </span>?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">❌ 反序列化标语结果失败</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📝 [文案生成] 生成标语: {sloganResult.Slogan}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发布自定义事件（将在后续定义）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> context.AddEventAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SloganGeneratedEvent(sloganResult), cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sloganResult;
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理审核反馈（改进优化）
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> ValueTask&lt;SloganResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HandleFeedbackAsync(
        FeedbackResult feedback,
        IWorkflowContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构造反馈消息</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> feedbackMessage = $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            以下是对你之前标语的审核反馈：
            评论: {feedback.Comments}
            评分: {feedback.Rating} </span>/ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            改进建议: {feedback.Actions}
            请根据反馈改进你的标语，使其更加精准有力。
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">;</span>
        Console.WriteLine($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🔄 [文案生成] 接收到反馈，评分: {feedback.Rating}/10</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用 Agent 改进标语（保持对话上下文）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._agent.RunAsync(feedbackMessage, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">._thread, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> sloganResult = JsonSerializer.Deserialize&lt;SloganResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(result.Text)
            </span>?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">❌ 反序列化标语结果失败</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📝 [文案生成] 改进后标语: {sloganResult.Slogan}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发布事件</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> context.AddEventAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SloganGeneratedEvent(sloganResult), cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sloganResult;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>在这个Executor中，需要注意以下几点：</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>（1）在实例化Agent时配置结构化输出，<span><strong>严格输出强类型的JSON格式数据</strong><span>；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>（2）需要<span><strong>重写ConfigureRoutes方法配置消息路由</strong><span>，即从处理初始任务开始，并设置处理反馈闭环；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>其工作机制如下：</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span><span>当接收到string消息（即用户的任务信息）时，调用 HandleInitialTaskAsync 方法进行首次生成；</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><span>当接收到FeedbackResult类型消息（即质量审核反馈的消息）时，调用 HandleFeedbackAsync 方法进行改进生成。</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>（3）在调用完Agent获取响应之后，需要将其<span><strong>进行强类型的反序列化输出</strong><span>；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>（4）最后通过<span><strong>发布自定义事件进行工作流传递</strong><span>，这里是 SloganGeneratedEvent；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>（5）<span><strong>通过AgentThread实现对话历史保持</strong><span>，而不是每次从头开始。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h1 data-pm-slice="2 3 []"><span>开发质量审核Executor</span></h1>
<p>在质量审核中，假设我们有如下的审核逻辑：评分&gt;=8代表通过审核可以发布，评分&lt;8则发送反馈继续循环，如果编辑次数&gt;=3次则需要终止循环输出当前版本文案。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 审核反馈 Executor - 评估标语质量并提供反馈
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> FeedbackExecutor : Executor&lt;SloganResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AIAgent _agent;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentThread _thread;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> _attempts = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最低评分要求（1-10分）
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> MinimumRating { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; init; } = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最大尝试次数
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> MaxAttempts { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; init; } = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化审核反馈 Executor
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="id"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">Executor 唯一标识</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="chatClient"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">AI 聊天客户端</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> FeedbackExecutor(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> id, IChatClient chatClient) 
        : </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(id)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置 Agent 选项</span>
        ChatClientAgentOptions agentOptions = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
            instructions: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是一名专业的文案审核专家。你将评估标语的质量，并提供改进建议。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        )
        {
            ChatOptions </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置结构化输出：要求返回 FeedbackResult JSON 格式</span>
                ResponseFormat = ChatResponseFormat.ForJsonSchema&lt;FeedbackResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
            }
        };
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._agent = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatClientAgent(chatClient, agentOptions);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._thread = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">._agent.GetNewThread();
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理标语审核
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ValueTask HandleAsync(
        SloganResult slogan,
        IWorkflowContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构造审核消息</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> reviewMessage = $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            请审核以下标语：
            任务: {slogan.Task}
            标语: {slogan.Slogan}
            请提供：
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 详细的评论（comments）
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>. 质量评分（rating，<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">10分）
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 改进建议（actions）
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">;</span>
        Console.WriteLine($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🔍 [质量审核] 开始审核标语: {slogan.Slogan}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用 Agent 进行审核</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> response = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._agent.RunAsync(reviewMessage, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">._thread, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 反序列化反馈结果</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> feedback = JsonSerializer.Deserialize&lt;FeedbackResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(response.Text)
            </span>?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">❌ 反序列化反馈结果失败</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📊 [质量审核] 评分: {feedback.Rating}/10</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发布自定义事件（将在后续定义）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> context.AddEventAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FeedbackFinishedEvent(feedback), cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 业务逻辑：判断是否通过审核</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (feedback.Rating &gt;= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.MinimumRating)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ✅ 通过审核</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.YieldOutputAsync(
                $</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                ✅ 标语已通过审核！
                任务: {slogan.Task}
                标语: {slogan.Slogan}
                评分: {feedback.Rating}</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                评论: {feedback.Comments}
                </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                cancellationToken
            );
            Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ [质量审核] 标语通过审核</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ❌ 未通过审核，检查尝试次数</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._attempts &gt;= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.MaxAttempts)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 达到最大尝试次数，输出最终版本</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.YieldOutputAsync(
                $</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span>                ⚠️ 标语在 {<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.MaxAttempts} 次尝试后未达到最低评分要求。
                最终标语: {slogan.Slogan}
                最终评分: {feedback.Rating}</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                评论: {feedback.Comments}
                </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                cancellationToken
            );
            Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">⚠️ [质量审核] 达到最大尝试次数，终止流程</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 🔄 继续循环：发送反馈消息回到 SloganWriterExecutor</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.SendMessageAsync(feedback, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._attempts++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🔄 [质量审核] 发送反馈，第 {this._attempts} 次尝试</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>在这个Executor中，除了之前提到的几点之外，我们还需要注意：</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span><span>在反序列化反馈结果及发布自定义事件之后，<span>需要嵌入评分逻辑<span>，即判断是否通过审核；如果通过审核，就及时结束循环；如果不通过，则发送反馈消息继续循环；</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><span>记录审核次数，如果达到设定的最大值，也<span>及时结束循环不恋战<span>！</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><span>通过 IWorkflowContext 的&nbsp;<span>SendMessageAsync 方法将反馈消息传递给其他参与者<span>，这里是 SloganWriterExecutor。</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h1><strong><span>构建工作流</span></strong></h1>
<p>现在万事俱备，只欠一个Workflow，现在Let's do it!</p>
<p>Step1: 获取ChatClient</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> chatClient = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OpenAIClient(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApiKeyCredential(openAIProvider.ApiKey),
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OpenAIClientOptions { Endpoint = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Uri(openAIProvider.Endpoint) })
    .GetChatClient(openAIProvider.ModelId)
    .AsIChatClient();</span></pre>
</div>
<p>Step2: 实例化自定义Executors</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> solganWriter = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> SloganWriterExecutor(id: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SloganWriter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, chatClient);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> feebackHandler = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> FeedbackExecutor(id: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">FeedbackHandler</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, chatClient);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ Executor 实例创建完成</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>Step3: 创建工作流</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> workflow = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WorkflowBuilder(solganWriter)
    .AddEdge(source: solganWriter, target: feebackHandler) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成 → 审核</span>
    .AddEdge(source: feebackHandler, target: solganWriter) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 审核不通过 → 重新生成</span>
    .WithOutputFrom(feebackHandler)                                      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 指定输出来源</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    .Build();
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ 工作流构建完成</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>Step4: 测试工作流</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定义产品任务</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> productTask = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请为马自达一款经济实惠且驾驶乐趣十足的电动SUV创作标语，要求结合马自达电车的特性来创作</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📋 产品需求: {productTask}\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📊 审核标准: 评分 &gt;= 8分</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🔄 最大尝试: 3次\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">⏱️ 开始执行工作流...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行工作流</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> run = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InProcessExecution.StreamAsync(workflow, input: productTask))
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 监听工作流事件</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (WorkflowEvent evt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run.WatchStreamAsync())
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用模式匹配识别不同类型的事件</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (evt)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SloganGeneratedEvent sloganEvent:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理标语生成事件</span>
                Console.WriteLine($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✨ {sloganEvent}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                Console.WriteLine();
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FeedbackFinishedEvent feedbackEvent:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理审核反馈事件</span>
                Console.WriteLine($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{feedbackEvent}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                Console.WriteLine();
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WorkflowOutputEvent outputEvent:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理最终输出事件</span>
                Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🎉 工作流执行完成</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{outputEvent.Data}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n✅ 所有流程已完成</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>测试结果如下图所示：</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>首先，获得了首次的文案撰写内容：</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251203214043905-396691260.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span>然后，第一轮审核评分6分并给出反馈：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251203214051623-1845699567.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>然后，文案撰写开始修改形成第二版文案：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251203214102552-1316284554.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>然后，再次评分为6分又给出反馈：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251203214112756-1945522991.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span>然后，终于获得审核通过（本次评分9分&gt;=8分），可以发布：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251203214125654-1981686785.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span>至此，工作流已经结束，可以看见，第三次生成的文案内容比前两次要好一些。</span></p>
<h1><span><strong><span>小结</span></strong></span></h1>
<p>本文介绍了Executor的基本概念 以及 如何开发自定义Executor，然后给出了一个营销文案生成审核的工作流案例详细介绍了自定义Executor的应用。</p>
<p>下一篇，我们将继续学习MAF中如何进行混合编排 Agent 和 Executor，覆盖实际场景中 确定性的业务逻辑 和 AI智能决策 的结合应用。</p>
